q2_gaps: a distributive predicate over a definite plural in OBJECT position ("drains the lanterns") — the per-member `(Implication (PartOf $x <group>) …)` distribution rule is specified only for the subject/agent side, so a lantern named later is not queryable as drained
notes: "West Row" follows the Kestrel-River pattern exactly — one opaque symbol, one `Name`, the kind word inside the name giving `(Member west_row row)` and no `(Member west_row west)` — and the indefinite witness, definite-plural group, `Patient` for the changed object, opaque `Possession` for the of-genitive and the unmarked present tense are all as specified.
